title: Smoothed annular monotonicity inequalities for a fixed cutoff width
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P any set, R = (M, θ, ξ) an IMRep U n with μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M, W ⊆ U open, κ ∈ ℝ, H : ℝ^P → ℝ^P μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |H(x)| ≤ κ for all x, such that x ↦ p_x (orthogonal projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x) is μ-a.e. strongly measurable and R.firstVariation X = −∫⟨X, H⟩dμ for every C¹ compactly supported X with tsupport X ⊆ W. Let y ∈ ℝ^P, A > 1 and 0 < s < t with B̄_{At}(y) ⊆ W (closed balls), put c := Aκ and F_y(x) := |(x − y) − p_x(x − y)|²/|x − y|^{n+2} (0 at x = y). Then, in [0, ∞] (lower Lebesgue integrals of ofReal F_y; real coefficients entered through ENNReal.ofReal): (i') ∫_{B̄_t(y)∖B̄_{As}(y)} F_y dμ + e^{cs}s^{−n}μ(B̄_s(y)) ≤ e^{ct}t^{−n}μ(B̄_{At}(y)); (ii') e^{−ct}t^{−n}μ(B̄_t(y)) ≤ e^{−cs}s^{−n}μ(B̄_{As}(y)) + Aⁿ∫_{B̄_{At}(y)∖B̄_s(y)} F_y dμ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid P → Euclid P) (κ : ℝ), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → ∀ (y : Euclid P) (A s t : ℝ), 1 < A → 0 < s → s < t → closedBall y (A * t) ⊆ W → (∫⁻ x in closedBall y t \ closedBall y (A * s), ENNReal.ofReal (‖(x - y) - (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - y)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - y‖ ^ (n + 2)) ∂R.measure) + ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (A * κ * s) / s ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall y s) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (A * κ * t) / t ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall y (A * t)) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(A * κ * t)) / t ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall y t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(A * κ * s)) / s ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall y (A * s)) + ENNReal.ofReal (A ^ n) * ∫⁻ x in closedBall y (A * t) \ closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(x - y) - (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (x - y)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - y‖ ^ (n + 2)) ∂R.measure
